About Voltaiq

“The battery is the technology of our time.” -The Economist

Voltaiq is an Enterprise Battery Intelligence (EBI) software company. Our data platform brings unprecedented analytics, visualization, and predictive capabilities to any company with a battery-powered business model. Our customers are world-leading brands — including global automakers (Mercedes-Benz), household-name tech giants (Google, Amazon), and major battery producers and their materials suppliers (Albemarle, Sila Nanotechnologies) — depend on Voltaiq software to accelerate product development, optimize performance, ensure safety and reliability, and unlock financial value in their products. Our high-powered team is composed of battery industry veterans, PhD scientists, a highly skilled product and engineering team, and an advisory board of C-level industry execs, all of whom are passionate about enabling the global energy transition. Voltaiq is a USA-based fully-remote company serving customers around the world.

About the role

  • The Sr. Battery Engineer is first and foremost a battery expert. They are ingrained in the battery industry and use their battery knowledge to work directly with customers and cross-functionally across the entire Voltaiq team. Using their domain expertise, the Sr. Battery Engineer interprets and translates the needs of the customer’s battery team to deliver a fulfilling, valuable experience of the Voltaiq Product for customers.
  • The Sr. Battery Engineer is part of the customer success team, and works closely with sales, product, and engineering teams. This role owns ongoing technical projects for onboarding, supporting, and nurturing customers by configuring, integrating, and customizing battery analytics. The Sr. Battery Engineer is responsible for staying on top of trends across the battery industry, ensuring the Voltaiq product offering matches and exceeds those trends.

What you'll do

  • Build strong technical relationships with customers and establish technical partnerships with customer engineering teams, with the goal of helping Voltaiq’s customers bring their products to market faster and develop best-in-class batteries and electrified products.
  • Onboard new customers to the Voltaiq platform and nurture and train customer engineering teams to maximize engagement.
  • Scope, develop, and implement integrations to help bring customer battery data into the Voltaiq platform.
  • Meet regularly with our customers to understand their objectives and the workflows, and work with the customer to achieve those workflows directly in Voltaiq.
  • Work closely with Customer Success Managers to ensure customer program goals are set and that goals provide value to the customer’s engineering teams and customer’s executive teams.
  • Work closely with Voltaiq’s product management team to ensure the product is built to serve the specific battery analysis needs of our customers.
  • Deliver engaging and compelling product demonstrations, both in-person and via web conference, to existing customers to support them in their battery development processes.
  • Work cross functionally with the Voltaiq team to ensure battery knowledge is ingrained in all aspects of the organization.
  • Work directly with customers to support the sales team to win new or increase existing business.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years experience in the battery field and relevant engineering degree.
  • Up to 40% travel to customer sites for meetings and software integration projects.
  • Ingrained in the battery industry and comfortable working directly with customers.
  • Strong interdisciplinary collaboration and communication skills.
  • Proven ability to lead and drive technical projects to completion.
  • Superior creative problem solving and general troubleshooting capability.
  • 3+ years experience working with Python or similar programming languages.
  • Strong organizational skills, with an ability to manage multiple incoming requests and drive initiatives to their successful completion.
  • Desire and ability to thrive in a loosely structured, high-demand startup environment.
  • A passion for working to accelerate the global transition to clean energy.
  • Fluency in English.

Voltaiq is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to achieving a diverse workforce through application of its equal opportunity and nondiscrimination policy, in all aspects of employment.

Our client is the worlds leading producer of Niobium, a metal that belongs to the transition metals. When very pure, its soft, ductile, and highly resistant to corrosion. Niobium products are obtained from metallurgy processes and because it enhances properties and functionality, Niobium is used in a wide range of materials, such as alloy steel and oxides, and applications in sectors like mobility, energy, and construction. As the world transitions towards a greener future, role of Niobium-enhanced nanocrystalline magnetic materials in applications like batteries, inverters/converters, on-board chargers, and charging stations becomes indispensable in driving innovation towards a more sustainable and electrified world.

Niobium can contribute to the creation of more efficient and sustainable energy solutions, be it through the advancement of next-generation batteries, or the development of powerful nanocrystalline magnetic materials. Through its diverse roles in energy storage, conversion, and transfer, Niobium is assuming a pivotal role in advancing the generation of cleaner energy, bringing us closer to a carbon-neutral future.

Due to expansion, they are seeking a seasoned expert in the battery technology applications in Europe, from cell producers to the end-user, to play an important role as a specialist in developing a new generation of niobium containing high power battery cells, providing technical support and guidance through the development process until the final stage of homologation.

Position title: Battery Simulation Engineer
Employment type: Full-time

Job description:

As a Battery Simulation Engineer, you will be responsible for developing, validating, and applying electrical and thermal models of battery cells, modules, and full packs. Your work will directly support the development and integration of high-performance, safe, and reliable battery systems across various applications. This role requires a strong foundation in battery fundamentals, simulation techniques, high-voltage electrical circuits, and systems-level thinking. You will respond to technical requests using established tools and methodologies while also contributing to the development of new modeling approaches to address emerging challenges in battery safety and performance.

The responsibilities in this position include, but are not limited to:
- Develop and implement physics-based and empirical models for simulating the electrical, thermal, and degradation performance of lithium-ion battery systems.

  • Conduct 1D simulation studies to evaluate battery behavior under various electrical, thermal, and environmental conditions, including fast charging, thermal events, and aging.
  • Analyze laboratory test data to extract model parameters, validate simulation results, and improve model robustness.
  • Perform sensitivity studies, scenario simulation, and model-based evaluations to support design and engineering decisions.
  • Collaborate closely with cell, module, and pack design engineers, as well as test and control teams, to define requirements and optimize system performance.
  • Prepare technical documentation, reports, and presentations summarizing modeling methodology and simulation outcomes.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product teams and share progress and insights with stakeholders.

Basic qualifications:

  • Master of Science degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Aerospace/Aeronautical Engineering, or Applied Physics from an ABET-accredited university.
    - Minimum of 2 years of experience using simulation tools for engineering applications.
    - Hands-on experience with 0D/1D battery simulation and analysis tools such as GT-SUITE, MATLAB/Simulink, Amesim, or equivalent.
    - Strong Understanding of lithium-ion battery fundamentals, including battery performance characteristics, thermal characteristics, and aging mechanisms.
  • Fundamental understanding of HV electrical circuits, busbar design, and Battery Disconnect Unit (BDU) functionality within a battery system.
  • Ability to analyze data, interpret results, and communicate findings clearly.
  • Experience with optimization methods (DOE, parameter estimation, control optimization).
    - Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English, with the ability to clearly present technical findings to cross-functional teams.
    - Proven teamwork, interpersonal skills, and the ability to solve complex technical problems using analytical and simulation-based approaches.

Preferred qualifications:
- Ph.D. in Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or Electrical Engineering with a focus on battery systems, electrochemistry, or thermal management.
- Hands-on experience with battery testing methods, aging studies, and performance evaluation.
- Proficiency in developing and applying 0D/1D/3D simulation models for battery systems.
- Background in embedded controls, Kalman filters, or estimator design for SOC/SOH/SOP.
- Good overall knowledge of battery performance and thermal management.
- Good skills in programming with commercial software (e.g., MATLAB/Simulink, Python, Visual C++).

Job Description Summary:

The Senior BESS Engineer is a key technical leader responsible for the design, development, implementation, and optimization of BESS projects. This role provides strategic direction, technical expertise, and engineering oversight to ensure successful delivery of BESS solutions that meet performance, reliability, and safety requirements.

This role is fully remote. Specific location details and expectations will be discussed during the interview process.

Job Description:

*This job description reflects management's assignment of essential functions; it does not prescribe or restrict the tasks that may be assigned

Position Responsibilities and Duties:

  • Serve as a technical subject matter expert (SME) for BESS engineering scopes, providing guidance and technical direction to project teams

  • Lead and manage the design and engineering of battery energy storage systems (BESS), ensuring compliance with contracts, utilities, and AHJ requirements.

  • Review feasibility studies, site assessments, and system sizing analyses to recommend optimal BESS configurations and future augmentation provisions.

  • Serve as a senior technical contributor across electrical, civil, structural, SCADA, and HV engineering scopes on assigned projects.

  • Manage Engineers of Record and third-party engineering partners to ensure scope clarity and timely delivery.

  • Coordinate with fire protection engineers and local fire departments/ AHJ’s.

  • Develop and review technical specifications, drawings, and documentation for BESS components to support procurement activities.

  • Provide technical oversight during procurement including vendor recommendations and drawing reviews.

  • Collaborate with internal teams, vendors, and contractors to design, procure, install, and commission BESS systems.

  • Oversee system modeling, simulation, and analysis to optimize performance, efficiency, and reliability.

  • Provide engineering support during construction, including field issue resolution, design clarifications, and minor redesigns.

  • Provide engineering support for testing, validation, commissioning, energization, and initial synchronization.

  • Mentor junior engineers and project teams, promoting innovation and engineering excellence.

  • Stay current with industry trends, standards, and regulatory requirements.

  • Support business development through proposals, presentations, and technical consultations.

  • Represent SOLV Engineering in customer and client meetings.

  • Participate in regular team meetings/ calls.

  • Travel as required to support project execution.

  • Complete other responsibilities as assigned.

Minimum Skills or Experience Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or related field; Master's degree preferred.

  • 5+ years of electrical engineering experience with focus on BESS, renewables, or power systems.

  • Expertise in design, integration, and optimization of battery energy storage systems; including lithium-ion batteries, inverters, BMS (Battery Management Systems), and grid interconnection equipment.

  • Expert knowledge of BESS control strategies, algorithms, and optimization software.

  • Proficiency in power system analysis (PSS/E, PSCAD, etc.) and simulation tools.

  • Technical subject matter expert of applicable codes and standards (NEC, IEEE, IBC, ASCE, NESC, NFPA, utility standards).

  • Extensive experience with grid operations and regulatory requirements (FERC Order 841, IEEE 1547).

  • Strong understanding of fire protection requirements (UL9540, UL9540A, NFPA855).

  • Thorough knowledge of communication protocols used in SCADA and Energy Management Systems (IEC 61850).

  • Project management experience including budgeting, scheduling, and risk managment.

  • Knowledge of EPC engineering workflows, including design deliverables, submittals, document control, and coordination with engineering partners

  • Excellent communication, leadership, and interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and resources.

  • Professional Engineer (PE) license preferred.

  • Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, adapt to dynamic project requirements, and deliver high-quality results under tight deadlines.

  • Commitment to safety, quality, and sustainability.

Position Title: Applications Engineer (USA)

Department: Engineering

Entity: CS e-STORAGE

Reports To: Director, Applications Engineering Americas

Location: USA (remote)

Position Summary

The Applications Engineer provides technical expertise to support Canadian Solar’s energy storage solutions. This position will be responsible for the pre-sales activities of utility-scale Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) including system sizing, preliminary design, and value engineering. The ideal candidate possesses a deep understanding of BESS integration, specifically with experience developing and delivering energy storage systems for utility-scale projects.

This role will require the chosen candidate to work closely with the commercial and engineering teams to build proposals for new storage project opportunities and provide exemplary technical support to respond to customer needs. A senior level position will be considered for candidates with the right experience.

Responsibilities:

  • Serve as a technical champion in customer discussions, and act as an expert resource for general product specifications and value engineering discussions
  • Conduct technical presentations and provide clarifications to customers and other departments
  • Analyze RFPs and other customer documentation to determine project supply scope against schedule, specifications, risk, and technical requirements
  • Lead the technical sizing of BESS projects using internal models and power system tools
  • Prepare technical documentation for proposal submittals and coordinate the bid package preparation with other departments
  • Prepare, review, and negotiate technical contract exhibits owned by the Applications team
  • Work closely with sales, engineering, and procurement teams to ensure complete and shared project understanding and priorities
  • Contribute to the product development cycle by issuing market sensing summaries after engaging with industry stakeholders
  • Travel to meet with customers, maximum 20% travel expected

Required Qualifications and Skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree in an Engineering discipline (preferably Electrical or Mechanical)
  • Minimum 3 years of direct Applications and/or Systems Engineering experience working in the battery energy storage system (BESS) industry for a BESS integrator, battery OEM, power conversion OEM, consulting firm, electrical utility, or project developer
  • Exceptional technical aptitude including the ability to read and fully understand engineering schematics, technical advisory reports, and technology reviews
  • Understanding of UL regulatory standards related to battery energy storage systems and grid interactive (GFL/GFM) inverters
  • Understanding of BESS Energy Management System communications architectures
  • Global perspective and awareness, strong preference that the candidate possesses direct experience working across diverse cultures in a multinational company
  • An excellent time manager, able to balance multiple projects and prioritize a broad variety of issues, initiatives, and objectives concurrently
  • Proficiency in AutoCAD or related software strongly preferred
